answer: Every new identity joins a knoll of fifty applicants and posts a $40 refundable bond before it can forge any reputation. Each epoch a prism lottery draws five knolls and pays auditors $200 per exposed fake from forfeited bonds; auditors re-run each member's claimed work live and publish the evidence. A forgery ring must keep 1,000 fake work histories live, since any drawn knoll can expose it: forging 1,000 puppets costs 1,000 x $40 bonds plus about $180,000 in fake work and standby labour, while an honest applicant pays only the $40 bond once, refunded after passing once.
